header.subtitleDefault: Here is what is happening across your registered agricultural parcels today.

landing.heroTitle: Smarter Farming Starts with Better Decisions
landing.heroSubtitle: Empower your agriculture with genuine DINOv2 computer vision leaf disease diagnosis, 8-factor crop planning, hyper-local weather alerts, and official India Post DIGIPIN micro-plot mapping.
landing.featuresSubtitle: Everything an Indian farmer needs to reduce crop risks and maximize farm profitability.
landing.feat1Desc: State-of-the-art quantized DINOv2 vision model running locally on your device with out-of-distribution leaf detection across 38 PlantVillage categories.
landing.feat2Desc: Agronomic recommendation engine analyzing soil pH, N-P-K nutrients, irrigation availability, and regional crop calendars.
landing.feat3Desc: Precise 3.8m x 3.8m agricultural micro-plot boundaries utilizing the official 10-character National Digital Addressing grid.
landing.feat4Desc: Real-time temperature, humidity, and 7-day agricultural risk forecasts derived from your field's exact geo-coordinates.
landing.howItWorksSubtitle: Simple, transparent, four-step decision workflow for everyday farming operations.
landing.step1Desc: Map your parcel with GPS or DIGIPIN, record soil type, water source, and existing crop variety.
landing.step2Desc: Capture a close-up leaf photo directly from your smartphone under natural daylight.
landing.step3Desc: Receive top 3 condition predictions with genuine probabilities and botanical profile descriptions in 100 milliseconds.
landing.step4Desc: Get tailored precautions combining leaf pathology with your field's soil moisture, weather, and fertilizer history.
landing.ctaTitle: Ready to Shield Your Farm from Crop Loss?
landing.ctaSubtitle: Join progressive farmers using FarmShield for proactive crop protection and higher profitability.
landing.footerText: FarmShield – Open-Access Smart Agriculture Platform. Designed for Indian Farmers.
